skipped.text: Instructions to use 3D primer for PP filament
skipped.reason: no property and value this line states together

skipped.text: Follow the instructions below for using the 3D primer with the PP filament:
skipped.reason: no property and value this line states together

skipped.text: 1º Open the primer bottle and apply it in the printing area.
skipped.reason: no property and value this line states together

skipped.text: 2º Wait about 5 min before print to let the primer dry.
skipped.reason: no property and value this line states together

skipped.text: 3º Set bed temp to 40ºC (not more temperature if not the part will warp).
skipped.reason: no property and value this line states together

skipped.text: 4º When the part is finished, heat up the bed up to 85ºC to release the printed part.
skipped.reason: no property and value this line states together
